title: ResearchPaper
description: Scholarly publication retrieved from public scholarly APIs (Crossref, OpenAlex, Europe PMC).

id.description: Internal UUID for the retrieved research paper

abstract.description: Abstract text retrieved from scholarly API

is_open_access.description: Whether the paper has legitimate open-access licensing

open_access_url.description: Direct URL to open-access landing page or repository

pdf_url.description: Direct URL to open-access PDF if verified

provider.description: Source public API provider (e.g., crossref, openalex, europe_pmc)

match_confidence.description: Similarity score between parsed citation and retrieved metadata

match_reason.description: Explanation of how match was established (e.g. 'Exact DOI match', 'High title fuzzy similarity')
